import numpy as np
print(np.unique(np.round(T,4)).size, np.unique(np.round(T,4))[:20])
for t in np.unique(np.round(T,3))[:6]:
    m = np.round(T,3)==t
    o = np.argsort(eps[m])
    print("T=",t, np.round(eps[m][o][:6],3), np.round(sigma[m][o][:6],3))
print(eps.min(), eps.max(), sigma.min(), sigma.max())

edges=np.linspace(2,6,9)
for i in range(8):
    m=(T>=edges[i])&(T<edges[i+1])
    if m.sum()<5: continue
    c=np.polyfit(eps[m],sigma[m],2)
    r=sigma[m]-np.polyval(c,eps[m])
    print(f"T[{edges[i]:.1f},{edges[i+1]:.1f}) n={m.sum()} quad={np.round(c,3)} rms={np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2)):.4f} meanT={T[m].mean():.3f}")
# regress sigma on T at eps fixed bins
edg=np.linspace(0.2,5,7)
for j in range(6):
    m=(eps>=edg[j])&(eps<edg[j+1])
    c=np.polyfit(T[m],sigma[m],2)
    print(f"eps[{edg[j]:.2f},{edg[j+1]:.2f}) n={m.sum()} Tquad={np.round(c,3)} rms={np.sqrt(np.mean((sigma[m]-np.polyval(c,T[m]))**2)):.4f}")
